description:
NAWCTSD intends to sole source this action to Kimball International (CAGE: 4V077), which is the OEM of the existing furniture system that our command currently has. It is the declared and acknowledged intention and meaning to provide new systems furniture in the DeFlorez Complex, and incidental related work, complete and ready for use, at the Naval Air Warfare Center Training Systems Division, 12221 Science Drive, Orlando, Florida 32826-3224.
Any responses are due to Stephen Wagner, Stephen.c.wagner10.civ@us.navy.mil, 407-380-4157 - no later than 1200 hours on 17 March 2026.
